scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install && cd ../student-client && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run server" "npm run client" "npm run student-client"
scripts.build: cd client && npm run build && cd ../student-client && npm run build
scripts.production: npm run build && NODE_ENV=production npm start
scripts.render-build: npm run install:all && npm run build
